title: HELIX Bridge: Ellucian Colleague → Institution
description: Maps the home institution and external schools from Colleague to the HELIX Institution resource.
architecture_notes: In Colleague, other schools are records in the INSTITUTIONS file, keyed by the same ID as their PERSON/CORP record. The home institution is one of those records, identified by the host institution setting in DEFAULTS. FLAG: confirm the host institution parameter at your school.

source_files.description: Institution records (home and external): type, CEEB and FICE codes, other identifiers.
Name and address for the institution's ID.
Host institution ID for the installation.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from the INSTITUTIONS record ID.

attribute_mappings.source: CORP name for the INSTITUTIONS ID
INSTITUTIONS ID, CEEB and FICE fields; configuration
attribute_mappings.transformation: Array of {system, value}: colleague_id, ceeb, fice, ipeds_unit_id, opeid. Multi-valued ID fields explode into array items.
Colleague type codes separate high schools and colleges; HELIX type comes from IPEDS. FLAG: confirm field name.
Load from the Carnegie Classification public file by IPEDS Unit ID. Refresh when a new edition is published.
IANA name, for example America/New_York. Set once per institution or campus.
'colleague' for the home institution. Null for external schools.
